fact: Ethiopia's report to the CRPD Committee states that government organs release public information in accessible formats (the Ministry of Health disseminated HIV/AIDS information in 2,500 audiovisual copies for the deaf and 2,000 braille copies for the blind), that sign language interpreters are deployed in government offices, and that a list of assistive technologies was added to the national procurement annex.
title: Combined second and third periodic reports submitted by Ethiopia under article 35 of the Convention (CRPD/C/ETH/2-3)
publisher: United Nations Committee on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities
